observation_summary: The StopWatch reports an incorrect elapsed time when stop() is called after a suspend() operation, as it includes the time elapsed during the suspension period.
reasoning_summary: The StopWatch class incorrectly updated the stopTime variable during the stop() method regardless of the current state. When the stopwatch was in a suspended state, calling stop() would overwrite the previously captured stop time with the current system time, effectively causing the stopwatch to continue counting time while it was supposed to be paused. The fix ensures that the stopTime is only updated if the stopwatch is currently in the running state, preserving the correct elapsed time when stopping from a suspended state.
